analysis.purpose: Surfaces framework relationships around a symbol — the route it exposes, the bean it produces, the dependencies its class injects, the JPA relations its fields declare — computed purely over the soul so the persisted dossier and the live context verb return byte-identical shapes.
responsibilities: Auto-scope by node: class-level aggregation versus method-level direct edges
Fold route, bean, dependency, relation and render edges into one object
Surface a dependency that is also bean-produced with its producer in the same object
Return undefined when nothing framework-related applies

businessRules.rule: Pure over the soul with no index or disk access, so the persisted dossier and the live context verb share one code path.
businessRules.rationale: Two code paths would drift and produce different shapes for the same node.

businessRules.rule: Dependency resolution is one hop only; multi-hop dependency injection remains the impact verb job.
businessRules.rationale: Bounds the cost and keeps responsibilities separate.

nodes.name: Framework semantics
nodes.summary: Resolved route/DI/relation view around a symbol.

evidence.why: The single aggregate shape returned for both dossier and context.
Dependencies are surfaced as first-class resolved records.
